bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money to the Agricultural Utilization Research Institute.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; AGRICULTURAL UTILIZATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE.

$4,388,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $4,434,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Agricultural Utilization Research Institute for the purposes of carrying out the duties under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 116V.
